name: Telnyx Voice AI
positioning: Telnyx is a licensed carrier and communications platform that also offers hosted voice AI assistants running on its own network and GPUs.

pricing.model: Per-minute voice engine fee (orchestration, hosted STT, hosted TTS) plus separately billed LLM tokens and telephony; no monthly platform fee on pay-as-you-go.
pricing.headline: $0.05/min voice engine; LLM tokens and telephony (from $0.0032/min inbound US) are added on top. Telnyx's own estimate for a typical production agent is about $0.06/min all-in.
planNotes: Pay as you go: $0 per month, standard rates, card on file, 500 concurrent calls, community support.
Growth: $2,000/month minimum spend, 15% discount on voice, messaging and numbers, 24/7 support.
Enterprise: $5,000/month minimum spend, dedicated infrastructure, unlimited rate limits.
Voice engine and LLM rates are stated to be the same on every plan; commitment lowers telephony, messaging and number charges.
Telnyx notes its estimates exclude per-call rounding to 60-second increments for the voice engine, so short calls can cost more than the headline suggests.
The rate was seen on two Telnyx pages (pricing page and developer docs pricing page); the all-in $0.06 figure is Telnyx's own estimate and was not independently reproduced.
pricing.freeTrial: Free sign-up with pay-as-you-go; developer docs say trial accounts are limited to 1 AI Assistant. The size of any trial credit was not stated on the pages read.
whatIsExtra: LLM tokens (about $0.006/min with Kimi on Telnyx GPUs per Telnyx; frontier models at their own rates)
Telephony from $0.0032/min inbound and $0.005/min outbound (SIP trunking)
Voice API platform fee $0.002/min (listed for component use)
SMS follow-up and agent knowledge base are listed as add-ons in the estimator

strengths.claim: Owns the carrier network and licensed-carrier status in 45+ countries per its own page, so telephony, numbers and AI come from one vendor and one invoice.
Low published per-minute price for the voice engine ($0.05/min including hosted STT and TTS) with LLM billed per token and no prompt-size multipliers stated.
Large voice and language catalogue: 1,400+ voices in 80+ languages on the product page, with several TTS and STT engines selectable.
Can import existing assistants from Vapi, ElevenLabs and Retell through the portal or an API.
Publishes a trust badge set (SOC 2 Type II, HIPAA, GDPR, PCI, ISO) and states HIPAA is included in every plan.

limitations.claim: The headline per-minute rate covers the voice engine only; LLM tokens and telephony are billed separately, so the all-in cost depends on model and call profile.
Telnyx states its cost estimates exclude per-call rounding to 60-second increments, so very short calls can cost more than the estimate.
Trial accounts are limited to one AI Assistant according to the developer docs.

integrations: 30+ pre-built integrations across 13 categories (CRMs, analytics, automation), per the product page
SMS, WhatsApp and web chat channels for the same assistant

compliance.note: Stated by vendor, self-attested: the product page shows SOC 2 Type II certified and a footer listing ISO, PCI, HIPAA, GDPR and SOC2 Type II; the pricing page says HIPAA is included in every plan. Reports and BAA terms were not reviewed (trust center page was not reachable).

telephony.providedNumbers: Telnyx-provided numbers across its global number product (US local $1.00/month, volume from $0.79/month). Docs describe assigning a Telnyx number to an assistant; whether an external carrier or SIP trunk can front a Telnyx assistant was not confirmed on the pages read.

stepsToLeave: Retrieve each assistant's configuration with the List assistants and Get an assistant API endpoints.
Retrieve call history with the List conversations and Get conversation messages API endpoints.
Telnyx documents a Clone Assistant endpoint that excludes telephony and messaging settings, so number assignments must be re-created on any new platform.
Number porting out is covered by Telnyx's number porting docs, which were not read in detail.

bestFor: Teams that want carrier, numbers and voice AI under one vendor and are comfortable assembling an agent from a developer platform with usage-based billing.

sources.title: Telnyx Voice AI Agents product page
Telnyx docs: Importing Assistants from another Provider

unknowns: Whether a customer can bring an external carrier or SIP trunk to a Telnyx AI assistant.
SOC 2 / HIPAA report or BAA terms (trust center page not reachable; claims taken from marketing pages).
Trial credit amount for new accounts.
Whether the $0.05/min voice engine fee is rounded up per call in practice (Telnyx mentions 60-second increments but the exact rule was not read).
